about: Vinnytsia: a compact city that keeps building

Vinnytsia is a compact city on the Southern Bug with lively construction of new residential complexes and cottage communities on its outskirts. Next to them are Soviet-era estates such as Vyshenka, with typical panel-block flats that owners replan and update.

For many clients in Vinnytsia the key is balance: a quality project and execution without overpaying. That is why we offer several packages, from the planning package (from $6 per m²) to the full one with designer supervision (from $45 per m²).

New Vinnytsia complexes have open-plan layouts that are easy to get wrong without a project: the designer places rooms, kitchen and storage so that not a single metre is lost. In houses the focus is on stairs, light and the connection with the plot. Design project from $30 per m² (minimum $2,500); packages are on the [interior design studio](/en/interior-design) page.

We renovate flats in shell condition and older homes with full replacement of services, as well as houses. In the suburbs we build one- and two-storey houses from aerated block, brick or timber frame; project, shell and finishing can be ordered together or in stages.

Renovation is carried out by our salaried team: from $550 per m² for works and rough materials, with finishing materials, furniture and appliances priced separately per estimate. Scope, schedule and payment plan (50/50, 50/30/20 or in stages, from a 10% advance) are fixed in the contract; team travel is on individual terms. Architectural design from $12 per m², house shell from $600 per m², turnkey with finishing from $1,100 per m² — see [turnkey renovation](/en/turnkey-renovation) and [house construction](/en/house-construction).

Design and approvals run online; we travel for measurements and key stages on the schedule set in the contract, and the terms and costs of travel and team accommodation are individual. Between visits you get photo reports every 1–2 weeks, and an online camera on site 24/7 is available for an extra fee.
